# KaySetu - Enterprise ERP & CRM Platform

> KaySetu is a unified ERP + CRM platform designed for fast-moving SME businesses, distributors, manufacturers, and field sales teams in India. It integrates sales, field operations, inventory, production, procurement, and accounts into one real-time, GST-ready workflow.

## Key Features & Capabilities

- **Field Sales Automation (SFA)**: Real-time beat planning, agent GPS tracking, offline order booking, distributor check-ins, and target tracking.
- **Inventory & Multi-Warehouse**: Batch tracking, expiry management, serial numbers, inter-godown transfers, and automated reorder points.
- **Production & Manufacturing**: Bill of Materials (BOM), work orders, shop-floor tracking, material issue, and scrap accounting.
- **GST & Financial Accounting**: GST invoicing, e-Way bills, GSTR-1 & 3B reports, customer ledgers, automated payment collection reminders, and P&L.
- **Procurement & Vendor Management**: PO creation, GRN inspection, vendor bills, 3-way matching, and supplier scorecards.
- **Leads & CRM Pipeline**: Multi-channel lead capture, quotation builder, deal stages, communication history, and sales analytics.
